ntini_2023_actb.citation: Ntini et al. (2023), Cell Systems 14, 906–922.e6, Figure 1 and authors’ transcript table
ntini_2023_actb.observable: Fit to the chromatin-associated fraction of recovered nuclear last-exon reads, CHR/(CHR + NP). RNA was labelled during synthesis. Time zero is the end of the pulse.
ntini_2023_actb.uncertainty: The authors' transcript table gives a point estimate for this row.
ntini_2023_actb.limit: The nuclear fractions pool transcripts that detached at different times. They do not supply a count at detachment for the same RNAs followed through the chase.

tutucci_2018_ash1.citation: Tutucci et al. (2018), Nature Methods 15, 81–89, Figure 6b–c
tutucci_2018_ash1.preparation: Live yeast with endogenously tagged ASH1
tutucci_2018_ash1.observable: Detected ASH1 mRNA spots per cell through mitosis, followed by their decline.
tutucci_2018_ash1.uncertainty: The Figure 6c value is printed as 6.1 ± 2.8 min. The type of the reported uncertainty is unspecified.
tutucci_2018_ash1.limit: Per-cell counts do not identify the time when each RNA detached from its template. The reported half-life has no matched count of RNAs at detachment.
